name: Last.fm API
tagline: Music metadata, charts, similar artists, and scrobbling from Last.fm’s listening graph
description: Public REST API for Last.fm music data: artist/album/track metadata and tags, similar artists, charts, user listening history (scrobbles), and authenticated write methods for scrobbling. Calls go to a single root with a method query parameter; responses are XML by default or JSON with format=json. Free self-serve API keys for non-commercial use; commercial/research use requires contacting Last.fm.

auth.details: Self-serve API account (API key + shared secret) via last.fm/api/account/create after a free Last.fm login. Read methods take api_key as a query parameter. Write/user methods need a user session (web/desktop/mobile auth flows) plus api_sig (MD5 of sorted params + secret).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use with self-serve API key; no published request quota. ToS caps stored Last.fm data at ~100 MB (Reasonable Usage Cap). Commercial/research use: contact partners@last.fm.
pricing.paid_plans: No public paid plans; commercial use negotiated via partners@last.fm

rate_limits: Not published as fixed numbers. Docs warn accounts may be suspended for continuous multi-request-per-second or excessive use; error 29 = rate limit exceeded (per IP/short period). Higher limits require partners@last.fm consent.
use_cases: get artist biography, tags, and similar artists by name
look up album metadata and tracklist by artist + album
search tracks and fetch track info / MusicBrainz IDs
fetch a user’s recent scrobbles and now-playing track
get global or country charts for artists and tracks
scrobble a played track for an authenticated Last.fm user
